errors.evidence: The "Only MoHD FFN" line starts at a value of approximately 11.45 at 100%, not 11.6. It is visibly below the horizontal "Transformer" line, which is at approximately 11.6.
The description of the "Only MoHD FFN" line as simply rising slightly is an over-generalization. The line first dips from ~11.45 at 100% to ~11.3 at 50% before rising to ~11.8 at 25%.

The "Only MoHD ATTN" line begins at approximately 11.45 at 100%, not 11.6. It starts at the same level as the "Only MoHD FFN" and "MoHD ATTN + MLP" lines, all of which are below the "Transformer" line.
For the "Only MoHD ATTN" line, the description incorrectly states that it dips. The line actually rises from approximately 11.45 at 100% to approximately 11.6 at 75%.
The final point for the "Only MoHD ATTN" line at 25% is approximately 14.2, as it is visibly above the 14.0 grid line.
The "MoHD ATTN + MLP" line starts at approximately 11.45 at 100%, not 11.6.
The value for the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" line at 75% is approximately 11.55, as it is below the horizontal "Transformer" line at ~11.6. The reported value of 11.7 is a significant overestimation.

errors.text_span: All lines show increasing perplexity as sparsity increases (i.e., as activated parameters decrease), with “Only MoHD ATTN” exhibiting the steepest degradation at lower parameter ratios.
errors.evidence: This concluding sentence violates the prompt's instruction to avoid making comparisons between lines ("steepest degradation") and to avoid interpretations. It also includes an over-generalization ("All lines show increasing perplexity"), which is not true for the flat "Transformer" line or the "Only MoHD FFN" line that dips first.
